summary: Genius Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing a NYSE Regulation trading halt on November 10, 2026, triggered by an abnormally low share price, and its plan for a 1-for-10 share consolidation effective 12:01 a.m. ET on November 20, 2026, with trading expected to resume split-adjusted that day under symbol GNS. No price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated; a new CUSIP will follow via press release. The action addresses NYSE American continued-listing price standards rather than any transaction. Watch for resumption mechanics, post-split price support and further listing-compliance risk.
